description:
Amentum is seeking a Python Software Developer to join our U.S. Marine Corps advanced technology development team in Dahlgren, VA.

 This position supports a unique research and development (R&D) mission involving software development, testing, and optimization of advanced weapon systems. The Software Engineer will be responsible for developing software code, resolving defects, improving system performance, and supporting test bench laboratory operations to ensure efficient testing.

 The position involves working in a collaborative development environment, supporting advanced technologies and software systems while contributing to process improvements and mission success.

 Python Software Developer Responsibilities Include: 

 Develop software code and resolve defects using Agile development processes throughout the software development lifecycle and testing cycle.
 Measure and analyze computer processing time and system performance to identify opportunities for improvement.
 Develop methods to optimize disk space utilization, network loading, and system throughput.
 Design, develop, and maintain software support tools and models.
 Support the operation of a test bench laboratory to ensure efficient and effective testing activities.
 Apply computer science principles and Python programming knowledge to software requirements, design, coding, testing, and debugging.
 Perform software development activities, including planning, design, coding, testing, and documentation.
 Collaborate with the R&D supervisory team on complex software development projects.
 Communicate effectively with team members and stakeholders regarding technical requirements, software development activities, and project objectives.
 Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance software development processes and system performance.
 Perform other position-related duties as assigned or requested.
 
 Minimum Requirements: 

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field and two (2) years of experience; or a Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or Electrical Engineering with zero (0) years of experience.
 Understanding of and experience with programming in Python through college coursework, as well as C, C++, or C#.
 Two (2) years of program- or project-level experience in software design.
 Two (2) years of experience performing detailed and complex software design and development to meet sub-millisecond timing requirements.
 Knowledge of software requirements, architecture, design, coding, testing, debugging, and documentation.
 Strong communication skills and technical proficiency in software development.
 Must be able to obtain and maintain a Secret U.S. Government security clearance. (Note: U.S. citizenship is required to obtain a Secret clearance.) 
 An interim Secret security clearance is required to begin employment; an active clearance is not required at the time of application.
 
 Preferred Qualifications: 

 Two (2) years of experience with Python programming.
 Experience working in an Agile software development environm
        
 Compensation Details: 
$90,000 - $110,000        
 The compensation range or hourly rate listed for this position is provided as a good-faith estimate of what the company intends to offer for this role at the time this posting was issued. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as job responsibilities, education, experience, skills, internal equity, market data, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and relevant laws.
  
 Benefits Overview: 
 Our health and welfare benefits are designed to support you and your priorities. Offerings include:
 Health, dental, and vision insurance

 Paid time off and holidays

 Retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching)

 Educational reimbursement

 Parental leave

 Employee stock purchase plan

 Tax-saving options

 Disability and life insurance

 Pet insurance

  
 Note: Benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and applicable agreements. Positions governed by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), the McNamara-O'Hara Service Contract Act (SCA), or other employment contracts may include different provisions/benefits. 
        
 Original Posting: 
11/20/2026 - Until Filled Amentum anticipates this job requisition will remain open for at least three days, with a closing date no earlier than three days after the original posting. This timeline may change based on business needs.
